terms.def: In this app, a labelling change with its trigger, the markets it affects, their deadlines and the label versions it produces.
The company's global reference for a product's indications, dosing, safety and use. Local labels are written from it.
The safety part of the CCDS; the reference safety information for periodic reports.
The list of places where a local label differs from the CCDS, each with a justification.
The point when packs carrying the new labelling are being distributed.
The company group that decides changes to the CCDS.
Whether an adverse reaction is in the CCSI (listed) or not (unlisted), in periodic safety reports.
Finding where each CCDS statement appears in a local label and recording whether it is aligned, deviating or not applicable.
A proposed one-page FDA patient sheet with fixed headings (proposed 2023, not final).
Under 505(o)(4), the holder's statement, with reasons, that no labelling change is warranted.
A table of agency comments with the company's decision, reason and the resulting text change.
